xxHash Fast Hash Algorithm
===========================

Source: https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash
Commit: bab7e27f4c6ae4efbb83dd99ae8a554423571635
Date downloaded: 2025-08-27
Branch: dev

Files included:
- xxhash.h (single-header implementation)

License: BSD 2-Clause License

Note: xxHash is an extremely fast non-cryptographic hash algorithm, working at
RAM speed limits. We're using the single-header implementation which includes
all necessary code inline.

Usage: Define XXH_IMPLEMENTATION in exactly one .c/.cpp file before including
the header to get the implementation.
